caption: The drawing shows a full-length dress with long, wide sleeves. The dress features a design made up of vertical stripes in blue, yellow, and mauve tones, with a background of off-white. The material is illustrated with a subtle checked pattern formed by the intersection of the colored stripes. The dress has a fitted bodice and a wide, pleated skirt that extends to the floor. There are six buttons down the front torso, each with a tassel below it, and the edges of the sleeves and shoulders are decorated with fringed trim. The bodice is shaped with seams that create a V at the waist, and the sleeves are gathered at the shoulders and cuffs, creating fullness. The garment is depicted on a plain, light background, without any figure or additional objects present.
title: Dress
